content: User-stated rule: "Never use ports 9010, 9012 or 9013 in this project." applies to the current project implementation.
Assistant will adhere to the rule and avoid using ports 9010, 9012, or 9013 in this project.
User-stated rule: "In this project, never bind test daemons to ports 9014 or 9114."
Assistant will not bind test daemons to ports 9014 or 9114 in this project.
User-stated rule: "For all future tests, reserve ports in the range 19000-19999."
User-stated rule: "From now on, never retry HTTP status 409 automatically in this project." This applies to the HTTP client retry logic for this project.
Implementation finding: The HTTP client will not automatically retry responses with HTTP status 409, complying with the user‑stated rule.
User-stated rule: "In this project, HTTP status 429 retries must honor Retry-After."
Will follow the standing rule that HTTP status 429 retries must honor Retry-After.
User-stated rule: "provider error AP-409 must be preserved exactly in reports."
Assistant will preserve provider error AP-409 exactly in reports as required.
User-stated rule: "For future exports, preserve the original workspace slug exactly."
User-stated rule: "In this project, all report dates must use ISO-8601" (applies to report generation and any component handling report dates).
User-stated rule: "In this project, all export files must use UTF-8."
Assistant will use UTF-8 for export files in this project.
User-stated rule: In this project, never push the 2.0 branch before local acceptance.
User-stated rule: "In this project, use smartmem-dev for every GitHub push."
Will follow the standing rule to use smartmem-dev for every GitHub push.
Assistant will not commit package-lock.json except in Base44 repositories.
User-stated rule: "In this project, never send live email from tests."
User-stated rule: "For this project, count timeouts in milliseconds, not seconds."
Will count timeouts in milliseconds for this project.
Assistant will limit retries to at most three attempts for all future jobs in this project.
User-stated rule: "In this project, API version 2.0 is a version, not an HTTP status."
Assistant will treat API version 2.0 as a version, not an HTTP status, following the user-stated rule.
User-stated rule: "For future refund identifiers in this project, retain the RV prefix."
Assistant will follow the standing rule and will not delete a completed checkpoint when a sibling fails.
User-stated rule: "For this project, a 30 percent threshold is a ratio, not a port number."
